title: should hide stream selects and clone a composite alert into the same folder
verifies: the composite clone dialog hides the stream selects and Save creates a second composite in the same folder

title: should preserve composite identity when cloned (not flattened to simple)
verifies: the cloned alert keeps alert_type=composite and the same child-referencing expression

title: should route a composite clone into a different folder
verifies: changing the destination folder lands the clone in that folder, not default

title: should cancel the clone dialog without creating an alert
verifies: Cancel dismisses the dialog and no new alert is created

title: should clone a composite whose child alert was deleted
verifies: an id-based composite clone still succeeds with a stale child reference
